title: AWS AppSync to Amazon DynamoDB - SingleTable
description: Create an AWS AppSync API endpoint with a custom resolver to Amazon DynamoDB using a single table design

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The SAM template deploys an AppSync API, a DynamoDB table, a GraphQL schema and a custom resolver that demonstrates a Single Table design on Amazon DynamoDB that is formatted for AppSync.

bullets.text: DynamoDB Office Hours - Building a Single Table Design SAM template for AWS AppSync

testing.headline: Testing
text: 1. Once the application is deployed, open the AppSync console at https://us-west-2.console.aws.amazon.com/appsync/home ensuring you are in the same region that the API was deployed to.
2. See the repo for additional testing notes.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus"
